observation: Empirical Telemetry Observation: Multi-agent blackboard queries show a 3.2x latency surge when context window contains unranked historical memories versus relevance-ranked memories.

hypothesis.hypothesis_statement: Attention head dispersion across irrelevant memory tokens degrades decoding throughput non-linearly.
hypothesis.causal_mechanism: Softmax attention over unranked tokens causes quadratic key-value cache cache-line contention.
hypothesis.test_prediction: Relevance-ranked top-5 context will reduce decoding latency by > 5x compared to 100-item unranked context.
hypothesis.falsification_criteria: Latency difference is < 1.5x with statistical p-value > 0.05 across 20 trials.

synthesis.universal_principle: Relevance-ranked memory pruning strictly bounds quadratic attention overhead, guaranteeing deterministic cognitive throughput.
